title: Algerian Toast with Almond Paste
description: A traditional Algerian snack made with crispy toast, almond paste, and a hint of zesty spice. Easy to make and perfect for a quick bite.

ingredients.name: Zesty spice blend (e.g. ras el hanout)

instructions: Preheat a pan or griddle over medium heat.
Brush the bread slices with butter or oil.
Toast the bread until crispy and lightly browned.
Spread 1 tablespoon of almond paste on each toasted bread slice.
Sprinkle 1/4 teaspoon of zesty spice blend on top of the almond paste.
Drizzle 1/2 tablespoon of water over the spice blend to help it stick.
